Definition: of Hebrew origin (H5177); Naasson (i.e. Nachshon), an Israelite:--Naasson.
BiblicalUsage: Naasson is the Greek form of Nahshon, and he stands in the line that leads to David and to Christ. In Matthew 1:4 Naasson is the son of Aminadab and the father of Salmon, and in Luke 3:32 he appears again in the genealogy, the son of Aminadab.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the genealogies are not filler, because every name in them is a link in a promise. Naasson sits between Aminadab and Salmon, and the line runs straight through him to the King.
